description.value: The George Dawson Inn is a full-service 80-room hotel situated at Mile 0 of the Alaska Highway in Dawson Creek, a historic launching point for northern BC and Yukon travel. It offers an on-site restaurant, complimentary full hot breakfast, fitness centre access, and coin-operated laundry — solid practical amenities for a multi-day touring stop. The property is five minutes from Dawson Creek Airport and within reach of local restaurants and services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information. The amenities page confirms free Wi-Fi, coin-operated laundry, vending machines, on-site restaurant (though the /dining subpage returns 404, the restaurant is referenced on the amenities and front pages), and complimentary full hot breakfast. No mention of bike-specific services (secure storage, e-bike charging, bike wash, tools, pump) appears anywhere on the site, so those remain null. Phone and address on the website match OSM values; the postcode appears as 'VIG 4N9' on the website (likely a font rendering of 'V1G 4N9').
concerns: The /dining subpage returns a 404 error; the restaurant is still referenced on the front page and amenities page, so it likely exists but the dedicated page has moved or been removed.
Website postal code displays as 'VIG 4N9' (likely a font rendering issue where '1' appears as 'I'); OSM value V1G 4N9 is the correct Canadian format.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with a fully functional website, verified contact details, and a well-documented amenity set — a legitimate stop for touring cyclists on the Alaska Highway.

Laundry.detail: Self-serve coin-operated laundry machines on-site, listed as 'Self-Laundry Service' on amenities page

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site George Dawson Inn Restaurant referenced on front page and amenities page; also a snack bar listed

Vending machines.detail: 'Vending Machines' explicitly listed in hotel amenities on the amenities page
